# vendor/chintamani

© 1993–2026 Abhishek Choudhary. All rights reserved. AyeAI.

These files are copied byte for byte from [hindawiai/chintamani](https://github.com/hindawiai/chintamani) at commit `3ad8778` (13 June 2026): the Romenagri Transliteration System (`Romenagri/`), the guru shaili of the Hindawi Programming System, which is its C front end (`Hindawi/guru/`), the driver `hincc` with its companions (`Hindawi/hindrv/`), and Hindawi's own C sample (`Hindawi/samples/HindiC.uhin`). They are the author's work under the GNU GPL, version 2 or later, as their headers state; `Romenagri/copying` is the licence text they ship with.

Nothing here is edited. `examples/hindawi.sh` copies them into `.work/`, builds them there with their own Makefiles, runs the demonstrations the guide prints, and removes `.work/`. Some of these files are encoded in ISCII rather than UTF-8, as the tree has them.
